text: DSH Deployment Rollback Proof 是一个面向 DSH 工具接口的离线部署回滚核验插件。它通过 DSH 工具检查显式提供的回滚清单，核对目标覆盖、观察记录、制品摘要、副本数量、时间窗口和证据新鲜度，并可生成内容寻址的报告。适合需要复核部署是否回到已知良好制品的开发与运维场景。插件不执行回滚；使用时需要本地 Node.js 22 或更高版本。

DSH Deployment Rollback Proof checks a supplied deployment manifest offline through DSH tools. It validates target coverage, artifact digests, replica counts, timing, and evidence freshness, then can write a content-addressed report. It requires Node.js 22 or later and does not execute rollback.
想核对一次部署失败后所有目标是否恢复到了原来的良好版本。
需要根据回滚清单检查各环境的制品摘要和副本数是否一致。
I need to verify that every deployment target converged to the last known good artifact after a failed release.
DSH Deployment Rollback Proof 的功能「回滚收敛核验」：通过 DSH 的核验工具读取清单和制品目录，检查目标覆盖、环境与事件绑定、已知良好摘要、副本收敛、时间窗口和证据有效期，并写出可按摘要识别的报告。
DSH Deployment Rollback Proof 的功能「清单摘要检查」：调用 inspect 工具并传入清单 JSON，返回证明标识摘要、失败与已知良好制品摘要、声明目标数和观察记录数。

dsh-deployment-rollback-proof README · DSH Deployment Rollback Proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Offline, deterministic evidence that every declared deployment target stopped serving one failed artifact and converged within RTO to the same last-known-good digest.

dsh-deployment-rollback-proof README · DSH Deployment Rollback Proof：This plugin **does not execute rollback**, authenticate receipts, grant authorization, observe live infrastructure, or prove application correctness. It verifies an explicit, hash-only manifest. That boundary is deliberate:

dsh-deployment-rollback-proof README · DSH Deployment Rollback Proof：- [`dsh-rollback`](https://github.com/Taler97/dsh-rollback) restores file mutations; this plugin never mutates a deployment.
- [`dsh-recovery-proof`](https://github.com/dongsheng123132/dsh-recovery-proof) verifies isolated recovery drills; this plugin verifies post-incident deployment-target convergence.
- The DeepSeek Harness rollback handbook is a runbook; this plugin produces a machine-readable settlement verdict.
- [`dsh-artifact-promotion-proof`](https://github.com/dongsheng123132/dsh-artifact-promotion-proof) proves positive promotion settlement; this plugin proves failed-version removal and last-known-good restoration.

dsh-deployment-rollback-proof README · Evidence model：The manifest declares the failed digest, last-known-good digest, incident/authorization/plan receipt hashes, RTO and freshness limits, exact target set and replica counts. One observation per target binds a rollback receipt and health-probe hash to the incident and plan. The verifier checks:

dsh-deployment-rollback-proof README · Evidence model：Only hashes, counts, timestamps and verdicts enter the report. Keys named like `secret`, `authorization`, `raw`, `body`, `content`, `log`, `prompt` or `chat`, plus secret-shaped values, are rejected.

dsh-deployment-rollback-proof README · Use：```bash
npm test
node bin/dsh-deployment-rollback-proof.mjs inspect examples/rolled-back.json
node bin/dsh-deployment-rollback-proof.mjs verify examples/rolled-back.json
```

DSH installs the bundle from `cordis.patch.yml` and exposes:

- `dsh_deployment_rollback_inspect`
- `dsh_deployment_rollback_verify`

dsh-deployment-rollback-proof README · Use：The standalone stdio MCP server exposes `deployment_rollback_inspect` and `deployment_rollback_verify`. The DSH verifier writes only beneath an explicit workspace-relative `artifactDir`, rejects path escape/symlinks, creates a content-addressed report exclusively, and verifies it by read-back.

dsh-deployment-rollback-proof README · Manifest：See [`examples/rolled-back.json`](examples/rolled-back.json). Inputs are claims bound by hashes, not authenticated facts. A `rolled-back` verdict means only that the supplied structured evidence satisfies the declared policy.
dsh-deployment-rollback-proof README · Security：See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Node.js 22 or later is required. Licensed under MIT.

dsh-deployment-rollback-proof README · DSH 部署回滚收敛证据：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

这是一个离线、确定性的证据插件：验证显式清单中的每个部署目标，是否在 RTO 内停止服务失败制品，并全部收敛到同一个最近已知良好（last-known-good）摘要。

它**不执行回滚、不认证回执、不授予权限、不访问线上系统，也不证明应用业务正确**。它只验证结构化、仅含哈希的清单：目标集合完整、观察序号连续、观察者数量达标、环境绑定一致、失败版本副本为零、良好版本副本数量吻合、事件与回滚计划绑定、时间顺序/RTO/新鲜度合格。

与相邻项目的边界：`dsh-rollback` 会恢复文件，本插件不做任何部署写入；`dsh-recovery-proof` 验证隔离恢复演练，本插件验证真实事故之后的目标收敛证据；`dsh-artifact-promotion-proof` 证明正向发布，本插件证明失败版本已经退出并恢复到 LKG；回滚手册提供操作步骤，本插件提供机器可读判决。
